title: First Job Cash
desc: Set up direct deposit from your new part-time job.
to-teach: Route income directly to a checking account.
hints: Your checking account balance is zero and bills are pulling from it.
Route 100% of your job income directly to the Main Checking account.

client.name: Sam
client.description: Sam just started working at a cafe and has paychecks coming in unallocated while bills fail to clear.
client.prompt: I see my wage node, but none of the money is going to my checking account to pay my bills!
